title: Ujwalam clip labels (one file per session in data/labels/)
description: Written by the A6 labelling page. Windows are on the session timeline (seconds from the session start in data/sessions.json). windowEndSec must be greater than windowStartSec; JSON Schema cannot compare fields, so tests and the writer enforce it. Version 1 gained three optional parts on 2026-10-28 (events, timing, highlightsEditedAfterSuggestions); older files stay valid. No free-text field: every string is an enum, a const or a strict pattern (medal: a pattern plus the pack catalogue check). Notes are never part of a label file; the page keeps them in a gitignored local file (2026-10-28). That an event's detectorId and medal exist in the session's game pack is checked by the export writer (tools/label/labels-export.mjs), the pre-commit hook (tools/git-hooks/private-scan.mjs) and a test, not by this schema.

events.description: Pass 2: verdicts on detector suggestions and events the labeller added. Times only, no OCR text.

highlightsEditedAfterSuggestions.description: true when the highlight labels changed after the labeller opened pass 2 (blind protocol broken for this session).

id.description: Sequence id (e-0001...); the export writer renumbers events in time order.

detectorId.description: A detector id from the session's game pack (detectors.json).

timeSec.description: Session timeline, seconds. For an accepted suggestion this is the time after any adjustment.

medal.description: Medal text from the pack's events.json (a game term, not a name). Only for detectors with a catalogue. The export writer and the pre-commit hook accept only entries of the pack catalogue.

highlightPassSec.description: Active labelling seconds in pass 1 (idle over 60 s not counted).

id.description: Sequence id (l-0001...); the export writer renumbers windows in time order.

reasonTags.description: Tag ids. The export writer and the pre-commit hook also require each to be an id in data/label-tags.json (JSON Schema cannot read that file).

labeller.description: Always the placeholder <user>. Real names are never committed (pre-commit hook: tools/git-hooks/private-scan.mjs).
